A Lion, though by nature wild The tamed lion
John Newton printed it in 1779 in Olney Hymns, Book II, no. 93, under Isaiah 11:6.
Isaiah 11:6 the verse printed above it
The words as Newton printed them, 32 lines.
Newton printed the hymn under Isaiah 11:6. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the goat; the calf and young lion and fatling will be together, and a little child will lead them. ISAIAH 11:6 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ ISAIAH 11
A Lion, though by nature wild, The art of man can tame; He stands before his keeper, mild, And gentle as a lamb. STANZA I
